t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Based initial decisions on colour.  Eventually realised it was better to alternate between characters s and k.  Seems to be all about random luck.

vb_textbox.text: Initially, I felt biased towards the colours, particularly where the shades of colours between the gnome's hats and the houses behind corresponded or felt the same.  Eventually, I realised that this wasn't garnering consistent results.  I then tried to alternate between the "s" and "k" keys in a certain pattern.  I felt I was getting luckier.  By the end of the test I was sticking to one key for one multiplier type (e.g. the "k" key for 5x, and the "s" key for 1x).  I felt I got a good streak this way, but eventually results began to even out again.  I'd be disingenuous if I said that there is a particular strategy that is viable, and it seems to be mostly about luck.  Ultimately, this seems to be an exercise in trying to create a strategy to control entropy.  Not to mention, maintaining focus.  Good luck!
